name: Talkdesk
description: Talkdesk is a cloud contact center platform, positioned as "CCaaS for people, CXA for AI," that combines traditional contact-center software with autonomous, orchestrated AI agents for specific customer-experience tasks.
best_for: Contact centers wanting published per-agent pricing tiers, plus a no-contract small-business plan (Talkdesk Express), alongside autonomous multi-agent AI orchestration.
features: Multi-agent AI orchestration to "compose, deploy, and orchestrate specialized AI agents, each focused on a specific task, to execute real CX work"
Autonomous agent use cases including appointment scheduling/rescheduling, order status/tracking, travel disruption notifications, and payment information management
Built-in validation and continuous learning mechanisms for AI reliability, per Talkdesk's own site
Digital engagement (email, chat, SMS, social) with Studio & Routing, APIs, and real-time dashboards
Voice engagement with speech recognition and voicemail transcription
Custom reporting, screen recording, and workforce/performance management on higher tiers
Industry Experience Clouds with industry-specific features for financial services, insurance, healthcare, retail, travel, utilities, and government
pros: Publishes four named per-agent pricing tiers ($85-$225/user/month) rather than requiring a quote to see any number
Talkdesk Express offers 25 licenses plus $100 in usage credit with no contract, for US/Canada businesses under 50 employees
cons: Add-ons and personalized recommendations still require contacting sales rather than being priced on the public pricing page
Talkdesk Express is limited to the US and Canada and to businesses under 50 employees

tiers.name: Digital Essentials
tiers.notes: Digital engagement (email, chat, SMS, social), Studio & Routing, APIs, real-time dashboards.

tiers.name: Voice Essentials
tiers.notes: Voice engagement, speech recognition, voicemail transcription, routing, APIs.

tiers.name: Elite
tiers.notes: Everything in Essentials plus custom reporting, screen recording, performance management, and workforce management.

tiers.name: Industry Experience Clouds
tiers.notes: Marked "Best Value" on Talkdesk's pricing page. Everything in Elite plus industry-specific features (financial services, insurance, healthcare, retail, travel, utilities, government).

tiers.name: Talkdesk Express
tiers.notes: US & Canada only, for businesses under 50 employees. Includes 25 licenses plus $100 in free usage credit, with no commitment or contract required.

alternatives.name: Five9
alternatives.description: A cloud contact-center-as-a-service (CCaaS) platform for inbound, outbound, and blended customer engagement across voice and digital channels, built around its Genius AI suite.
alternatives.best_for: Contact centers wanting published bundle pricing and a dedicated Genius AI product line as an alternative to Talkdesk.
strengths: Published Digital ($119/seat/mo) and Core ($159/seat/mo) bundle pricing
Genius AI Agents, Agent Assist, and GenAI Studio
Omnichannel support across voice, email, chat, social, and SMS

alternatives.name: Genesys Cloud CX
alternatives.description: An enterprise contact-center-as-a-service (CCaaS) platform unifying contact center, digital channels, workforce engagement, and AI orchestration across voice and digital customer interactions.
alternatives.best_for: Large enterprises wanting a single platform for contact center, digital channels, and workforce management as an alternative to Talkdesk.
strengths: AI Experience tokens bundled per tier for orchestrated AI agents
Broad enterprise integration ecosystem (Salesforce, ServiceNow, AppFoundry)

alternatives.name: RingCentral
alternatives.description: A cloud communications platform (RingEX) that also offers RingCX, an omnichannel AI-powered contact center, alongside its core phone, video, and messaging suite.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting contact-center capability bundled inside a broader unified-communications platform rather than a dedicated, standalone CCaaS product.
strengths: RingCX omnichannel contact center with AI-powered quality management
Published per-user pricing from $20-$35/month for the core UC suite

faq.question: What is Talkdesk Express?
faq.answer: Talkdesk Express is a self-serve plan for US and Canada businesses under 50 employees, offering 25 licenses plus $100 in free usage credit with no commitment or contract required, according to Talkdesk's own pricing page.
